intended_program_or_role: Model: P(offer per app) = base rate (calibrated to published acceptance rates: Citadel 0.4%, GS/JPM 0.7%, McKinsey ~1%, Big4 0.85-4%, FAANG 2-4%) x international factor (0.9 sponsor-friendly, 0.65 verify, 0.35 future-sponsorship screeners, 0.15 clearance-heavy) x VT pipeline factor (2.0 verified feeders, 1.4 moderate, 1.0 none) x fit factor (1.5 econ consulting, 1.3 consumer/payments analytics, 0.6 quant, 0.85 elite pure-tech) x GPA factor (0.8 at 3.5-preferring firms, 1.0 else) x experience factor (1.25: three internships incl. one US brand by junior fall = top ~20% for your stage). Referral + week-1 application = x2.5 (referrals ~4x interview odds per Zippia; rolling admissions reward early). Error bars are honestly +/-2x on any single row - the portfolio numbers are far more reliable than any individual cell. FINAL CALIBRATION: all raw model outputs multiplied by K=0.35 reality factor, because published acceptance rates overstate one person's realized per-application odds (postings close early, ATS mismatch, role-level mismatch, MS/PhD competition in DS pools). K chosen so the portfolio totals match observed outcomes of comparable candidates (~200 apps -> low-single-digit offers).
